name.baseName: Photovoltaic laminate, CdTe, First Solar Series 4, at plant

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Production technology of thin film cells. Sublimation of the powders and condensation of the vapours on a glass substrate by vapour transport deposition (VTD).

# Included processes
This dataset includes the raw and auxiliary materials, electricity, natural gas and water used to manufacture CdTe Series 4 PV modules at First Solar in the US. The transport of raw materials, the disposal of wastes, the infrastructure and pollutant emissions to air and water are also included.
